decision.question: review size
decision.why: mastermind read: diff is Live.js (log_url getter, card base url, now view), new LiveNow/LiveArchive/ArchiveMove, docs; headless shots at 400 and 1200 of /live/ and /live/archive/ read, ArchiveMove apply/undo round-tripped on a temp copy

decision.question: how to move the old /live cards
decision.chose: copy page.jsonl byte for byte to archive/, then append a clear and three view cards

options.option: rewrite page.jsonl with only the new cards
options.caveat: loses history and races the voice agent appending to the same file; would win only if the history were worthless
/live's log keeps the old lines; undo is a re-append

decision.question: what makes the Now card live
decision.chose: LiveNow reuses LiveToday.load (session index and task logs), in flight = active in the last 30 min

options.caveat: only the server can call it; the static page cannot

options.option: socket tail of the session index
options.caveat: the better fix, needs the session writer to expose a stream; noted in doc/notes.md

decision.question: live-pointers: build now or defer
decision.chose: neither: it had landed (b9cf153f8); the archive move plus the Now view finish it

options.option: build a second pointer card system
options.caveat: a second version of the same thing (law 6)

assign.title: checkup: the /live page
assign.outcome: /live is a blank slate (Now, Tasks, Archive views); old cards kept at /live/archive/; five tasks verified and closed; see checkup.md
